question: Calculate the duration of each track, classify them as short, medium, or long, output the minimum and maximum time for each kind (in minutes) and the total revenue for each category, group by the category.
sql:
WITH track_stats AS (
    SELECT 
        MIN(CAST(Milliseconds AS DOUBLE) / 1000.0 / 60.0) as min_duration,
        MAX(CAST(Milliseconds AS DOUBLE) / 1000.0 / 60.0) as max_duration,
        AVG(CAST(Milliseconds AS DOUBLE) / 1000.0 / 60.0) as avg_duration
    FROM Track
),
thresholds AS (
    SELECT 
        min_duration,
        max_duration,
        avg_duration,
        (min_duration + avg_duration) / 2.0 as short_medium_boundary,
        (avg_duration + max_duration) / 2.0 as medium_long_boundary
    FROM track_stats
),
classified_tracks AS (
    SELECT 
        t.TrackId,
        CAST(t.Milliseconds AS DOUBLE) / 1000.0 / 60.0 as duration_minutes,
        CASE 
            WHEN CAST(t.Milliseconds AS DOUBLE) / 1000.0 / 60.0 <= th.short_medium_boundary THEN 'Short'
            WHEN CAST(t.Milliseconds AS DOUBLE) / 1000.0 / 60.0 <= th.medium_long_boundary THEN 'Medium'
            ELSE 'Long'
        END as category
    FROM Track t, thresholds th
),
category_stats AS (
    SELECT 
        category,
        MIN(duration_minutes) as min_duration,
        MAX(duration_minutes) as max_duration,
        SUM(i.Total) as total_revenue
    FROM classified_tracks ct
    JOIN InvoiceLine il ON ct.TrackId = il.TrackId
    JOIN Invoice i ON il.InvoiceId = i.InvoiceId
    GROUP BY category
)
SELECT 
    cs.category,
    cs.min_duration,
    cs.max_duration,
    cs.total_revenue
FROM category_stats cs
ORDER BY cs.category
